title: North Korean Official Dismisses Reduced Drills Between US and South Korea
summary_full: Kim Yo-jong, a powerful adviser and sister of Kim Jong-un, also said she was “unaware” of any communication with Washington, contradicting President Trump’s claim her brother had responded to his outreach.
